newsitem.title: CZECH REPUBLIC: ATHLETICS-GARCIA WINS 50KM WORLD CUP THRILLER.
newsitem.headline: ATHLETICS-GARCIA WINS 50KM WORLD CUP THRILLER.

text.p: Spain's Jesus Garcia overhauled Oleg Ishutkin just 600 metres from the finish line to take a World Cup 50km walking event on Sunday.
Garcia won in three hours 39 minutes 54 seconds to finally put himself at the top of the medals podium.
The 1993 world 50km champion had finished second in the last two World Cup races over the same distance before landing gold this time and earning the $20,000 first prize.
Russia's Ishutkin, who had been in the lead from the 36-km mark, hung on for second in 3:40:12, while reigning 50km world champion Valentin Kononen, of Finland, finished third in 3:41.09.
Russia won the 50km team race and also took the Lugano Trophy, for the combined results of the men's 20km and 50km races.
The Slovak Republic finished second in the men's 50km race with Spain third.
Mexico took the silver medals in the Lugano Trophy with bronze going to Belarus.
